name: Japanese Taiyaki (Custard Filled) or Mochi Ice Cream
whyItWorks: Taiyaki is a warm waffle fish filled with smooth vanilla custard; Mochi is pounded glutinous sweet rice flour (0g fiber).
prepOrOrderInstructions: Crisp frozen custard taiyaki in the toaster oven for 5 minutes. Skip red bean (anko) fillings that contain bean skins during flares.
